history.revertTip: Revert this change and restore the script snapshot.
history.reverted: Reverted. The script is back to how it was.
history.title: Task history
history.unpinTip: Unpin: cleaned up with the retention policy

panel.agentNote: Edits the script file directly; a snapshot is taken before each run, so any change can be reverted.
panel.bakePrompt: Bake the current Tavotto visual edits into the Python source so a fresh run reproduces the final appearance without runtime overrides.
panel.bakeTip: Ask the coding agent to absorb the current Tavotto overrides into the script, then verify a fresh source-only render.
panel.emptyHint: The assistant edits the figure’s script directly; every change can be reviewed as a diff or reverted.
panel.noPanelHint: Figures marked editable come from a script, which the assistant can edit directly.
panel.placeholder: e.g. move the legend to the upper left
panel.runningHere: A task for this script is already running

session.bakeMismatch: Verification mismatch: the updated Python does not yet reproduce the Tavotto target without overrides. Review the diff, retry, or revert.
session.bakeVerified: Verified: a fresh run of the updated Python reproduces the Tavotto target without overrides. The current overrides are still kept in this MVP.
session.bakeVerifyFailed: The script changed, but source-only verification could not complete. Review the diff or revert.
session.doneChanged: Changes written to the script. View the diff or revert.
session.reverted: Reverted. The script is back to its previous state.
session.revertedStatus: Reverted the assistant’s change. Rebuilding the figure…

status.aiChanged: The assistant edited the script; re-rendering the figure…
status.aiChangedRefreshFailed: The assistant edited the script, but the project couldn’t refresh: {{reason}}. Your edit is saved, and Tavotto will retry automatically.
status.aiNoChange: The assistant finished; the script is unchanged
